description: Convert one date and clock time from a source time zone to other time zones, with daylight saving applied for that date, and find the stretch of the day when it is 9 AM to 5 PM in every zone at once. Use it to schedule across offices, pick a meeting time for a distributed team, or answer 'what is 3 PM Eastern in London?'. Supports 24 zones (US zones, UTC and major world zones); the valid zone ids are listed in the schema. Use time_duration_between for the length of time between two moments.

date.description: The date in the source time zone as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

from_time_zone.description: IANA id of the source time zone. Default America/New_York.

time.description: The clock time in the source time zone as a 24-hour clock time in the form HH:MM, for example 22:30.

to_time_zones.description: IANA ids of the zones to convert to, between 1 and 12 (for example ["America/Los_Angeles","Europe/London","Asia/Kolkata"]).

name: convert_time_zone

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Time zone converter
